properties.Name: East Tremont
properties.Description: Historic, vibrant neighborhood that was a hotspot for Jewish, Italian, and Irish families.

properties.Name: Crotona Park
properties.Description: Crotona Park was a historic green space that had a portion cut off due to the construction of the Expressway, decreasing the park from its original 155 acres.

properties.Name: Yankee Stadium
properties.Description: The infamous quote "The Bronx is burning" (in reference to the insurance fraud arson epidemic) was spoken during a broadcast of the 1977 World Series, held at Yankee Stadium. The Bronx burning around it was visible from the stadium.

properties.Name: Yonkers
properties.Description: The more well-to-do residents of the Bronx moved to Yonkers in response to the displacement from the Expressway and as a reaction to more people of color moving into the Bronx.

properties.Name: Harlem
properties.Description: In the 1960s, many Black families moved from Harlem to the Bronx.

properties.Name: Co-Op City
properties.Description: Many Jewish and Italian families moved to Co-op City in response to displacement from the Expressway being built.

properties.Name: Manhattan
properties.Description: The destruction of the 3rd Avenue Elevated Line cut off the Bronx from Manhattan, leading to property values plummetting.

properties.Name: Puerto Rico
properties.Description: The passage of the Hart-Celler Act led to widespread immigration to the U.S., with Puerto Rico being a huge source of immigration to the Bronx.

properties.Name: "Fort Apache" - The 41st Precinct
properties.Description: This was the home of the NYPD's 41st Precinct, nicknamed "Fort Apache" during the 1970s.

properties.Name: Engine Company 41-2
properties.Description: Firehouse that was closed on January 17th, 1974.

properties.Name: Ladder Company 71-2
properties.Description: Firehouse that was closed on December 16th, 1974.

properties.Name: Ladder Company 27-2
properties.Description: Firehouse that was closed on November 6th, 1972.

properties.Name: Engine Company 50-2
properties.Description: Firehouse that was closed on March 22nd, 1974.

properties.Name: Engine Company 88-2
properties.Description: Firehouse that was closed on November 22nd, 1972.
